Hogan |asst_coach2=Erik Crawford |asst_coach3=[[Seth Tuttle]] |stadium=[[McLeod Center]] |champion= Missouri Valley regular season champions |tourney=[[2022 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]] |tourney_result=Second Round }} {{2021–22 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Northern Iowa]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers, led by 16th-year head coach [[Ben Jacobson]], played their home games at the [[McLeod Center]] in [[Cedar Falls, Iowa]] as members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference]]. With a win over [[2021–22 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola]] on February 26, 2022, the Panthers won the regular season MVC championship.{{Cite web |last=Southard |first=Dargan |title=Northern Iowa basketball clinches Missouri Valley regular-season title with thrilling win over Loyola |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/northern-iowa/uni-panthers/2022/02/26/college-basketball-northern-iowa-panthers-loyola-ramblers-mvc-ncaa-missouri-valley-title-uni/6911212001/ |access-date=2022-03-03 |website=Des Moines Register |language=en-US}} They finished the regular season 18–10, 14–4 in [[2021–22 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC play]] to finish in first place. They defeated [[2021–22 Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball team|Illinois State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 Loyola Ramblers men's basketball team|Loyola]]. As a No. 1 seed who didn’t win their conference tournament, they received an automatic bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] where they defeated [[2021–22 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]] in the first round before losing in the second round to [[2021–22 BYU Cougars men's basketball team|BYU]]. ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2020-21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 10–15, 7–11 in [[2020–21 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|MVC play]] to finish in a three-way tie for fifth place. Former [[Missouri Valley Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|MVC Player of the Year]] and first-team all-MVC star [[A. J. Green (basketball)|A. J. Green]] played in only three games before he underwent hip surgery and missed the remainder of the season.{{cite news |last1=Bain |first1=Matthew |title=UNI point guard AJ Green will undergo season-ending hip surgery|url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/northern-iowa/uni-panthers/2020/12/13/uni-point-guard-aj-green-undergo-season-ending-hip-surgery/6531266002/ |accessdate=January 2, 2021 |work=[[Des Moines Register]] |date=December 13, 2020}} As the No. 7 seed in the [[2021 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|MVC tournament]], the Panthers defeated [[2020–21 Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball team|Illinois State]] in the first round. However, they were forced to forfeit their quarterfinal game against [[2020–21 Drake Bulldogs men's basketball team|Drake]] due to a positive COVID test and subsequent contact tracing within the UNI program.{{cite news |last1=Southard |first1=Dargan |title=Arch Madness basketball: Drake advances to semifinals after positive COVID-19 test within UNI program|url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/college/northern-iowa/uni-panthers/2021/03/05/arch-madness-basketball-uni-positive-covid-19-test-drake-missouri-valley-conference-mvc-semifinals/4602607001/ |accessdate=November 13, 2021 |work=[[Des Moines Register]] |date=March 5, 2021}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
